svg.title: A client who died carries a signed donor card, but the family tells the nurse they are opposed to donation. Which action should the nurse take?
svg.desc: The nurse's role is to report the potential donor and support the family while the procurement specialists handle the conversation and any legal questions about the documented wishes. Arguing the point or pressing the family exceeds the nurse's role and damages trust at the most vulnerable moment.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Donor Designation
Read the situation
A client who died carries a signed donor
card, but the family tells the nurse they
are opposed to donation. Which action
should the nurse take?
What fits here
Notify the organ procurement organization
and provide emotional support while
trained staff meet with the family
Why it fits
The nurse's role is to report the
potential donor and support the family
while the procurement specialists handle
the conversation and any legal questions
about the documented wishes. Arguing the
point or pressing the family exceeds the
nurse's role and damages trust at the most
vulnerable moment.
